description: Post a payload (text, carried as given) to a peer's key (to) through a relay that names that peer, or else the first relay this node is connected to; via names the one relay to use. Answers the post's outcome {ok, status, hash, from, text, sig, receipt}, under the relay's status when it is refused. patienceMs, at most 10 minutes, retries a busy peer until it is delivered or the time runs out; kind takes only 'background', which lowers the post's priority. Refused 503 when this node is not connected to a relay or the peer cannot be reached (also when via does not name it), and 400 for any other kind.
